fire: The crowd rose to thunderous cheers at the end.
A thunderous drum solo closed the concert.
The biopsy found only non-cancerous cells in the sample.
Precancerous lesions were removed from her skin.
His speech drew thunderous approval from the hall.
Some moles become pre-cancerous after many years.
The stadium shook with thunderous noise.
Non-cancerous growths are common at that age.
quiet: The crowd rose to polite cheers at the end.
A gentle piano solo closed the concert.
The biopsy found only harmless cells in the sample.
Small warts were removed from her skin.
His speech drew quiet approval from the hall.
Some moles grow darker after many years.
The stadium hummed with cheerful noise.
Harmless growths are common at that age.
